body.body:
={
  "model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
  "max_tokens": 400,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says remote.

Reject the job if:
- It requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.
- It requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.
- It is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.
- It requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

Keep the job only if one of these is true:
- The job says worldwide remote.
- The job says work from anywhere.
- The job says global remote.
- The job says APAC remote.
- The job allows international contractors.
- The job accepts people based anywhere.
- The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return JSON only, no other text:
{"taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear", "reason": "short reason", "location_risk": "low/medium/high", "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high", "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear", "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"}

Job post:
Title: " + $json.job_title + "
Company: " + $json.company + "
Location: " + $json.location_text + "
Description: " + ($json.description || '').substring(0, 1500)
    }
  ]
}

={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 600,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Jerry's background:
- Bilingual: English and Mandarin
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background
- Data science bootcamp experience
- Technical: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Marketing: Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Projects: Dashboards, EDA, machine learning, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Make the letter specific to this job:
Title: " + $json.job_title + "
Company: " + $json.company + "
Description: " + ($json.description || '').substring(0, 800) + "

Mention how Jerry can help the company:
- Reduce manual analysis time
- Improve reporting speed
- Connect marketing and data
- Build AI-assisted workflows
- Turn messy data into business action

Keep it under 220 words. Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.

Return only the cover letter text, no other explanation."
    }
  ]
}
